author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹುಟ್ಟುಸಾವುಗಳೆಂದು ಜೀವನದ ಎರಡುಕೊನೆ
ಹುಟ್ಟಿದವ ಸಾಯುವುದೆ ಬದಲಿಸದ ನಿಯಮ
ಜುಟ್ಟ ಹಿಡಿದಿರೆ ಸಾವು ಧರ್ಮದಲಿ ನಡೆಯದಿರೆ
ಕಷ್ಟಪಡುವೆಯೊ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Birth and death are life’s two ends;
that whoever is born must die is a law that does not change;
when death seizes you by the topknot, if you have not walked in dharma,
you will suffer, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Death is certain for everyone born. What decides whether its coming is hard is whether we have lived by dharma.
